what.text: This page follows refugees from Poland living in Canada, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 250 Polish refugees in Canada, 18.3% of all refugees from Poland.
Germany hosts the most Polish refugees, followed by Canada, Denmark and Sweden.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Poland, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1994 and 1995.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at its highest figure, 27732 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
These are year-end totals for Canada only, reported to UNHCR.
